title: Vasileios Dimitropoulos · Web Designer & Developer
description: Web designer and developer in Patras, Greece. Fast, clean websites and AI assistants for small businesses.

hero.name: Vasileios Dimitropoulos
hero.tagline: I design and build websites that look sharp, load fast and bring in customers.

services.title: What you can hire me for

items.name: New website
items.text: Design, build and launch. Ready for phones and for Google from day one.

items.name: Redesign
items.text: A fresh look and faster pages for a site that feels outdated.

items.name: WordPress care
items.text: Updates, backups, fixes and small changes, so you don't have to think about it.

items.name: AI assistants
items.text: Chat assistants that answer your customers in Greek and English, day and night.

work.title: Selected projects
work.note: Concept projects are designed for fictional businesses to show what I can build.

items.name: Personal portfolio
items.text: Bilingual static site, hand-coded with no framework. Fast, accessible and free to host.

items.name: AI guest assistant for a hotel in Paros
items.text: Answers guests in Greek and English, logs requests for staff and hands tricky questions to a person.

items.name: Café website
items.text: Menu, opening hours, location and online pre-orders for a neighbourhood café.

items.name: Boutique hotel website
items.text: Rooms, gallery and a direct booking request form for a small island hotel.

steps.name: Talk
steps.text: We agree on goals, budget and timeline in a short call.

steps.name: Design
steps.text: You see and approve the look before any code is written.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: I develop and test, and share progress as I go.

steps.name: Launch
steps.text: We go live together, and I stay around for support.

about.title: You talk to the person who builds it
paragraphs: I'm Vasileios, a web designer and developer based in Patras. I build websites for small businesses that want to look professional online without paying agency prices.
No account managers and no handoffs. You get quick replies, honest advice, and a site that's yours to keep. I also build AI assistants that take the repetitive questions off your plate.

contact.title: Got a project in mind?
contact.text: Tell me a little about it and I'll reply within one working day. Or book a free 20-minute call.
